readers.q6: Select the Army of Italy (the small box titled "The Army of Italy — Lannes, Murat") and press its "Hold..." button. The box says Hold, Fortify or Drill first shows each corps' order and price, and nothing is spent until you press Give. The box also says you could type "Army of Italy, hold" in the text line. Sending them would cost up to 4 actions, and you have 4.
readers.q8: Lannes is unticked because he needs 2 actions, and the two ticked corps (Ney and Davout) already use all 4 actions in hand. The box says to untick one of them (click his row, or use Up/Down and Space) so Lannes can go in that corps' place. The box does not say whether Lannes could be added on top by getting more actions. Soult is also left out, but for a different reason: he already stands at Lorraine.
